_comment: Copy to config/energy_coach.json. shiftable: sockets (switch.*) whose appliance can be moved into the sunshine, with the name as Jarvis says it. The coach never suggests rarely used sockets; it learns that itself (off at first sight = rare) or by voice: "I use the boiler often". battery_kwh: usable size of the storage. pv_peak_w: peak power of the panels, only until the evening calibration has enough days. hours: when he speaks up by himself. always_on: sockets that should run day and night (fridge, router) – they do not count as standby.
